status: the traced-loop weight functional of O8, exactly factorised. The weight of a length-n word is its Cartan-amplitude vector times the sector phase e^{i(eta/2) sum ev}; the sum of the weights is (MG)^n exactly (7.7e-17), and the factorisation F_n = N_n * r_n * I_n holds for every n = 2..10 to 2.3e-16: at n = 10 the three factors are multiplicity N = 55326, mean-word amplitude ratio r_10 = 4.399e-06 (per-hop 0.2913), interference I_10 = 0.0788, and the word norms do not depend on eta (phase cancels in a norm, 2.9e-18) - so all of the ladder factor is these three numbers. F_10 hits 1/(16 pi) exactly at 8 angles (nearest to the root: eta* = 0.1987); at the root angle eta = 0.2 the interference overshoots by the single named deficit factor 0.9644: which loops contribute is now a three-number functional and the unnamed weight of O8 is the root-angle interference deficit 0.9644
